commands.summary: Plan adding a channel, playlist, video, or asset to a YouTube Analytics group.
examples: pm youtube-analytics create group item apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: adds a channel, playlist, video, or asset to a YouTube Analytics group; redacts group/resource identifiers in write errors and requires reverse ETL plan, preview, and explicit approval
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan removal of an item from a YouTube Analytics group with typed destructive confirmation.
examples: pm youtube-analytics delete group item apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes an item from a YouTube Analytics group; destructive, redacts group-item id in previews/errors, and requires reverse ETL plan, preview, explicit approval, and typed confirmation
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Read one YouTube Reporting job by configured job_id.
examples: pm youtube-analytics jobs get --credential youtube-prod --config job_id=job_fixture_1 --json
commands.notes: Pass --config job_id=<job id>; ETL command flags intentionally map only to query parameters, not connector config path variables.

commands.summary: Read YouTube Reporting jobs through the declared ETL stream.
Read YouTube Reporting report types through the declared ETL stream.
Download generated YouTube Reporting report bytes to an explicit local destination.

flags.name: resource-name
flags.summary: Provider resourceName identifying the generated report; may contain safe path segments.

commands.notes: The required --resource-name maps to the provider resourceName. Runtime download flags require --dest-root; --file-name is optional. The executor refuses path traversal, overwrites, archive extraction, and payloads over 100 MiB, and emits only file metadata with a SHA-256 receipt.

commands.summary: Read one generated report metadata resource for the configured job_id/report_id.
examples: pm youtube-analytics reports get --credential youtube-prod --config job_id=job_fixture_1 --config report_id=report_fixture_1 --json
commands.notes: Pass --config job_id=<job id> --config report_id=<report id>; use reports download with the documented resourceName to fetch report bytes.

commands.summary: Read generated report metadata for the configured YouTube Reporting job.
examples: pm youtube-analytics reports list --credential youtube-prod --config job_id=job_fixture_1 --limit 25 --json
commands.notes: Pass --config job_id=<job id>; downloaded report bytes are intentionally not emitted by this JSON metadata stream.
